Christine Sheller, O3’s Director of Experience Design, will be speaking on AIGA’s national series, “One Designer, One Work” on Thursday, June 23 at 3 PM EST (12 PM PST).

After the event, AIGA, will post the full recap. Click here to register!

header.title: One Designer, One Work: Christine Sheller
header.description: The AIGA series features one designer showcasing a work that is personally meaningful. Christine will speak about Keith Haring, and about how his work in reproducing and commercializing his art helped her understand what a career in design could be.
